slides.title: Sudan rejects Ethiopia's offer to host talks

source: Source: AU Commission statement via Nile Post, Nov 26, 2026; SUNA, Nov 25, 2026

card.title: Any Sudan dialogue should be “inclusive, Sudanese-led and Sudanese-owned.”
card.body: AU Commission Chairperson Mahmoud Ali Youssouf, Nov 25, after Khartoum rejected PM Abiy's Nov 24 offer to host talks, citing neutrality concerns. Ethiopia denies Sudan's allegations.
